implementation.storage: 4-bit Hadamard Lloyd-Max K, 4-bit uniform V; 32-token DSP pages
implementation.decode: HVX grouped GQA, split-KV, QK 12-bit centroid LUT with scaled Q16, PV 15-bit weights, FP32 softmax/output
implementation.prefill: same packed state; HVX on S23; FP16 HMX uses bounded tile callback where supported
implementation.host_transfers: current Q/K/V rows and output use ION; no full-history FP16 seed
implementation.moe_integration: resident ATTN_M1 graph retained; packed state shared across prefill and native decode
implementation.compatibility: single conversation; rejects INT8 session, prefix snapshot, paged and seed options

checks.kv_regressions: PASS: device sessions, radix, LRU, snapshots, paged/linear/COW/window

benchmark.method: 10 repeated attention-only calls, one layer, D=128, KV heads=2, Q heads=4. Same seed71 Gaussian inputs rounded to FP16 for all methods. RPC wall time includes current-row append. CPU single-thread reference. No MoE weights. Single run, no controlled thermal/power conditions.
benchmark.legacy_scale: DSP Q8/FP16 require scale rounded to FP16; TurboQuant and CPU use exact FP32 1/sqrt(D).
benchmark.memory: page payload includes metadata and guard; excludes page-pointer tables, allocator overhead and worker scratch. packed_bytes is CPU manager backing, not DSP payload.

limitations: No full Gemma4 MoE checkpoint execution, task quality/perplexity or end-to-end token throughput measurement.
Synthetic FP16-vs-4bit relative L2 is about 14%; this is not model quality validation or vLLM bit-level equivalence.
Integer DSP compute introduces a small additional approximation; scalar packed output parity bounded at 3e-4 for tested inputs.
S23 lacks FP16 HMX: callback/tile conversion tested, actual FP16 HMX attention compute remains untested.

S23 binary built in isolated temporary copy with existing v73 compatibility shims (H44 fallback, QFloat conversions, synchronous DMA, 64KiB worker stacks); unchanged production v73 build still has compatibility work.
No full platform build matrix or full application HTP link run.
